latency_throughput_cache_wait_and_clinic.detail: 10 passed. Reports p50 and p95 for successful measured stages with explicit denominators; computes throughput units per second separately from queue wait; carries per-channel model-cache hit, model-load and inference timing; records review wall/active durations while explicitly marking active time unverified.

ruff.command: ruff check services/throughput_measurement.py tests/test_throughput_measurement.py tests/test_workflow_metrics.py tests/test_channels.py

limitations: Metric values are synthetic test fixtures and do not establish production throughput or measured clinical latency.
Clinician active task time remains self-reported and explicitly unverified; independent timing study data is unavailable.
Cache-hit, wait-time and throughput fields are recorded separately, but this is not a production telemetry rollout.
